post.description:
Submit the current interaction.
- Submit the verified user identity to the OIDC provider for further authentication (SignIn and Register).
- Update the user's profile data if any (SignIn and Register).
- Reset the password and clear all the interaction records (ForgotPassword).
- Complete a step-up interaction: the interaction must have reached the authentication context class the authorization request selected, and only the methods it established are written to the account, with no sign-in side effect.

200.description: The interaction has been submitted. A sign-in with requested `acr_values` that cannot reach any requested class, even through first-factor establishment or MFA enrollment, finishes with the OIDC error `unmet_authentication_requirements`. Follow `redirectTo` to return the error to the client; no sign-in side effect runs.

403.description:
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is enabled for the user but has not been verified (SignIn and Register).
- A sign-in with requested `acr_values` still lacks a Logto-verifiable first factor (`session.step_up.require_verification`); the response data carries the selected authentication context class, the available methods, and the masked identifiers.
- The achieved authentication context does not satisfy the requested authentication context class (`session.step_up.acr_not_satisfied`); no interaction result is written.

422.description:
The user profile cannot be processed because it is invalid, conflicts with existing data, is already in use, or lacks required fields.
- A sign-in with requested `acr_values` has no eligible method but holds a fresh subject proof (`user.missing_profile`); `data.isEstablishment` is `true` and `data.missingProfile` lists alternative first-factor methods the tenant allows the user to establish. Establishing any one method fulfills this requirement; tenant-mandated profile fields are checked separately on the next submission. When `data.isEstablishment` is absent, every entry in `data.missingProfile` is required.
- Requested MFA requires enrollment (`user.missing_mfa`); `data.availableFactors` lists the factors to bind.

403.description:
The `SignIn` or `Register` interaction is disabled in the experience settings.
- In a step-up authentication, the verification resolves to an account other than the pinned subject, or a social or enterprise SSO verification resolves to no account or asks to link the identity (`session.identity_conflict`); a step-up never registers or links an account.
